title: Dashboard
description: Renders a grid of widget apps placed in the current screen's `apps[]` array with `slot: "grid"`. Each tile mounts its widget through the shared `MountedApp` resolver so cap gating + theming apply uniformly.

screenId.description: Screen id injected by the v3 compiler. The host reads `config.screens[screenId].apps[]` for its widget list.

grid.label: Dashboard Grid
grid.description: Tile grid that lays widgets out by CSS Grid auto-flow, honoring per-entry size + position overrides.

documentation.purpose: Host app for the dashboard widget grid — and the workspace dashboard screen (replaces the retired core:dashboard monolith, issue #133). Renders a time-of-day greeting header (host chrome) above a CSS Grid of widget tiles. Reads screens[id].apps[] filtered by slot: "grid"; manifest slotHints provides size + position defaults; per-entry size / position override per-property at the install layer. Each tile mounts the widget app via the shared MountedApp resolver so the existing 4-layer cap gating + theming applies uniformly.

reads.purpose: Acting-user id — used to look up the user record for the greeting header's display name.
Acting user's display name for the greeting header (useEntityRecord('root','user', userId), null-safe on a falsy id).
Screen id the v3 compiler injected into the route config — used to look up `config.screens[screenId]`.
List of screen-app entries; the host filters to `slot === 'grid'` and renders the survivors as tiles.
Read each widget app's `slotHints` block for default size / position before per-entry overrides apply.

states.renders: Grid of tiles, one per surviving widget.

states.when: composeScreenWidgets() returns an empty list (no `slot: grid` entries on the active screen, or missing manifests)

a11y.focus-management: Tab order follows the order entries appear in `screen.apps`. Each tile is a plain `<div>` — the widget app inside owns its own landmarks via the kernel's region wrapper if it declares a role.

constraints.note: An app participates iff a `screens[id].apps[]` entry references it with `slot: "grid"`. Manifest `slotHints` only supplies defaults — it's not an eligibility check. Programmatic registrations via `wp_admin_workspaces_register_dashboard_widget()` synthesize a screen-app entry under the target screen (`dashboard-widgets` by default).

The host is config-driven only — widgets are computed from `composeScreenWidgets({ screen, manifests })` once per (screen, manifests) tuple. Drag-to-reorder is out of scope; authors reorder via workspace.json `apps[]` ordering and `position` overrides.

design-system-leakage.purpose: The host is DS-light — it renders structural `<div>` chrome only. Widget tiles inherit WPDS via the active engine's chrome bindings.
